faq.answer1:
We empower both individuals and organizations through two main channels:

For Individuals: Professional certifications (like PMP and CAPM) to advance your career.

For Organizations: Comprehensive solutions including PMO Setup, Maturity Assessments, PMIS implementation, manpower support, and fully customized training programs.
faq.question2: How is your exam simulator unique?
faq.answer2:
Our simulator features two intelligent modes:

- Practice Mode: Learn without pressure. Answer questions and get immediate feedback with detailed explanations.

- Exam Mode: Experience the real test. Complete timed exams and receive a personalized report highlighting your strengths and areas for improvement.

It also automatically creates a "Lesson Learned" review list from your incorrect answers for focused study.
faq.question3: Can I try the simulator before purchasing?
faq.answer3: Yes. We offer a free demo with 10 sample questions where you can test both Practice and Exam modes to experience the quality firsthand.
faq.question4: Is your content up-to-date with certification standards?
faq.answer4: Absolutely. Our material is continuously updated to match the latest exam content outlines. Combined with our practical application focus, we prepare you not just to pass the exam, but to apply the knowledge effectively in real-world scenarios.
faq.question5: How do I join your professional community?
faq.answer5: When you enroll in any of our programs, you gain access to our support network. For corporate clients, this extends to strategic services that move beyond theory into execution, providing end-to-end support for your organizational goals.

pmpFaq.question1: What does PMI and CAPM mean?
pmpFaq.answer1:
PMI (Project Management Institute): The global leader in project management standards and professional certifications.

CAPM (Certified Associate in Project Management): PMI's foundational certification designed for individuals starting their project management career, validating understanding of fundamental knowledge, terminology, and processes as defined in the PMBOK® Guide.
pmpFaq.question2: What makes your CAPM exam simulator unique compared to other platforms?
pmpFaq.answer2: Our CAPM simulator is engineered to build confidence for first-time exam takers. It features a dynamic bank of 600 questions aligned with the current exam outline, and two smart modes: a Practice Mode for learning with instant feedback, and a Timed Exam Mode to simulate real test pressure, complete with performance analytics to pinpoint your strengths and areas for growth.
pmpFaq.question3: Are your questions like the real CAPM exam?
pmpFaq.answer3: Absolutely. Our questions are meticulously crafted to mirror the style, format, and difficulty level of the official CAPM exam, focusing on the knowledge areas and process groups outlined in the PMBOK® Guide (6th & 7th Editions). We ensure you practice with the exact question types you will encounter.
pmpFaq.question4: What do I need to apply for the official PMI - CAPM exam?
pmpFaq.answer4:
You need to fulfill these 2 simple requirements:

1. Education: A secondary degree (high school diploma or global equivalent).

2. Project Management Education: 23 contact hours of formal education in project management. You will receive these required hours upon completion of our CAPM course.
pmpFaq.question5: Which official Project Management Institute (PMI) book should I study for the CAPM exam?
pmpFaq.answer5: The CAPM exam is based primarily on the concepts found in the PMBOK® Guide (6th Edition) and its processes, and it also incorporates principles from the PMBOK® Guide (7th Edition). The Agile Practice Guide is a valuable complementary resource. Our CAPM course synthesizes all essential content from these guides into a structured, easy-to-follow curriculum, so you don't need to navigate them alone.
